SummaryEndpoint makes every field optional, types `type` as a string and `result` as `number | string`, and adds an index signature, so code that reads a field as a number or a literal union needs a check.
SummaryEndpoint has an index signature and optional fields, so TypeScript no longer checks the option names or that `type`, `destinationRow`, and `destinationColumn` are set.
UndoRedoAction is `{ actionType: string; [key: string]: unknown }` and replaces the union of the 11 action interfaces, so narrowing on `actionType` no longer types the other fields.
BorderSettings has an index signature and no named `style` field (it reads as `unknown`), and it adds `cornerVisible` and `className` besides `width`, `color`, and `hide`.
NestedHeaderSettings makes `label` optional and adds an index signature.

rules.reason: Settings is deprecated in 18.0 and removed in 19.0.

rules.name: Settings
rules.advice: Use `GridSettings['{optionKey}']` (import type { GridSettings } from 'handsontable'). The option is typed loosely in 18.0, often `boolean | object`.

rules.name: Settings
rules.advice: Use `boolean`. `GridSettings` has no typed key for the {plugin} option in 18.0.

rules.name: Settings
rules.advice: Use `boolean | NotificationConfig` (from 'handsontable/plugins/notification'). `GridSettings` has no typed key for the notification option in 18.0.

rules.name: Settings
rules.advice: Use `NestedHeader[][]` (import type { NestedHeader } from 'handsontable/plugins/nestedHeaders'), or `GridSettings['nestedHeaders']`.

rules.name: Settings
rules.advice: Use `DataProviderConfig | undefined` (import type { DataProviderConfig } from 'handsontable/plugins/dataProvider'), or `GridSettings['dataProvider']`.

rules.name: DetailedSettings
rules.advice: Remove the annotation and type the callback parameters yourself. To type one menu item, use `MenuItemConfig` from 'handsontable/plugins/contextMenu'.

rules.name: DetailedSettings
rules.advice: Remove the type and the `as DetailedSettings` cast. The `formulas` option accepts the object as it is. To keep an annotation, use `GridSettings['formulas']`.

rules.name: DetailedSettings
rules.advice: Use `Exclude<NonNullable<GridSettings['{optionKey}']>, boolean>`. Import GridSettings from 'handsontable'. For an option typed as an array, such as collapsibleColumns or customBorders, add `[number]` to get one item. The result is a loose `object` in 18.0, so TypeScript no longer checks the shape.

rules.name: SortOrderType
rules.advice: Use `Exclude<ColumnSortingConfig['sortOrder'], 'none'>`. Import ColumnSortingConfig from 'handsontable/plugins/columnSorting'. Its `sortOrder` also allows 'none', which SortOrderType did not.

rules.name: Direction
rules.advice: Use the inline union `'vertical' | 'horizontal'`.

rules.name: Endpoints
rules.advice: Read the endpoints from the plugin instance (`hot.getPlugin('columnSummary').endpoints`) and let TypeScript infer the type. 18.0 removed this type with no replacement.

name: CommentConfig
CommentsRangeObject
rules.advice: Use `GridSettings['comments']`, or describe the object inline. 18.0 removed this type with no replacement. `CommentObject` is still exported.

rules.name: MenuConfig
rules.advice: Use `Record<string, MenuItemConfig | PredefinedMenuItemKey>`. Both types are exported from 'handsontable/plugins/contextMenu'.

name: SubmenuConfig
SubmenuItemConfig
rules.advice: Use `MenuItemConfig` from 'handsontable/plugins/contextMenu'. A submenu is `{ items: MenuItemConfig[] }`, and a submenu item key is 'parent_key:sub_key'.

rules.name: Selection
rules.advice: Use the inline type `{ start: CellCoords; end: CellCoords }` (import type { CellCoords } from 'handsontable').

rules.name: SeparatorObject
rules.advice: Use the inline type `{ name: string }`.

name: BorderRange
BorderDescriptor
ComputedBorder
rules.advice: Describe the object inline, using `BorderSettings` from 'handsontable/plugins/customBorders' for the sides, or use `GridSettings['customBorders']`. 18.0 removed this type with no replacement.

name: DialogConfig
TemplateOptions
LoadingConfig
EmptyDataStateConfig
EmptyDataStateMessage
rules.advice: Use `GridSettings['{optionKey}']` (import type { GridSettings } from 'handsontable'), or describe the object inline. The option is typed `boolean | object` in 18.0. 18.0 removed this type with no replacement.

rules.name: ConditionName
rules.advice: Use `ConditionId['name']` (import type { ConditionId } from 'handsontable/plugins/filters'). It is typed `string`, where ConditionName was a union of the built-in condition names such as 'eq' and 'contains'.

name: FiltersConfig
CellLikeData
rules.advice: Use `GridSettings['filters']`, or describe the object inline. 18.0 removed this type with no replacement.

name: HyperFormulaSettings
NamedExpressions
rules.advice: Use `GridSettings['formulas']`, or describe the settings inline. `HyperFormulaSettings` was `Partial<ConfigParams> & { hyperformula: typeof HyperFormula | HyperFormula }`, with `ConfigParams` from 'hyperformula'. A named expression is `{ name: string; expression: RawCellContent; scope?: number }`. 18.0 removed this type with no replacement.

rules.name: MergeCellsSettings
rules.advice: Use `GridSettings['mergeCells']`, or describe the object inline. 18.0 removed this type with no replacement.

rules.name: DOMBoundaries
rules.advice: Use the inline type `{ left: number; right: number; top: number; bottom: number }`.

name: PageSizeOption
PaginationData
rules.advice: Use `number | 'auto'` for `PageSizeOption`. For `PaginationData`, use `ReturnType<Pagination['getPaginationData']>` (import type { Pagination } from 'handsontable/plugins/pagination').

name: SearchCallback
SearchQueryMethod
rules.advice: Describe the function inline. `SearchCallback` was `(instance: Handsontable, row: number, column: number, value: unknown, result: boolean) => void`. `SearchQueryMethod` was `(queryStr: string, value: unknown, cellProperties: CellProperties) => boolean`.

name: CopyModeType
PasteModeType
rules.advice: Use the inline union. `CopyModeType` was 'cells-only' | 'column-headers-only' | 'with-all-column-headers' | 'with-column-headers'. `PasteModeType` was 'overwrite' | 'shift_down' | 'shift_right'.

name: CellAlignmentAction
ChangeAction
ColumnMoveAction
ColumnSortAction
FilterAction
InsertColAction
InsertRowAction
MergeAction
RemoveColAction
RemoveRowAction
UnmergeAction
rules.advice: Use `UndoRedoAction` from 'handsontable/plugins/undoRedo'. It is one shape for all actions, so narrow on `actionType`, and its other fields are `unknown`.

rules.name: Formats
rules.advice: Use the inline union `'csv' | 'xlsx'`.

rules.name: Plugins
rules.advice: Get a typed plugin from the instance with `hot.getPlugin('<key>')`. 18.0 removed this type with no equivalent.

name: CellTypes
Editors
Renderers
Validators
rules.advice: Use the string union that the registry entry points export instead: `CellType`, `EditorType`, `RendererType`, or `ValidatorType`. To type one cell type, editor, renderer, or validator, import it and use `typeof`. 18.0 removed this type with no replacement.

rules.name: BaseValidator
rules.advice: Describe the validator inline: `(this: CellProperties, value: unknown, callback: (valid: boolean) => void) => void`. 18.0 removed this type with no replacement.

rules.name: Shortcut
rules.advice: Describe one shortcut inline, or use `NonNullable<EditorFactoryOptions['shortcuts']>[number]` (EditorFactoryOptions is exported from 'handsontable/editors/factory'). It was never a public export.

rules.name: LanguageDictionary
rules.advice: Use `Record<string, unknown>`. That is what registerLanguageDictionary() accepts in 18.0.

rules.name: CellSettings
rules.advice: Use `CellMeta & { row: number; col: number }`, which is what it was, or `CellProperties` when you also need `instance`, `visualRow`, `visualCol`, and `prop`.

rules.name: Omit
rules.advice: Use the built-in TypeScript `Omit`.
